direction: reviewed public code snapshot -> private production integration
public_snapshot_identity: transfer bundle SHA-256 and source tree inventory
private_adapters: Keep the existing private live-provider and publishing adapters. Public adapters deliberately disable live data and must not overwrite them.
integration_required: trusted human review before untrusted public code runs with private access
explicit file-level patch allowlist, no private -> public mirror
private base commit + target merge commit + public source SHA + bundle digest mapping
core API/schema compatibility checks; full private data tests and current review gates
original frozen/isolation failures cannot be bypassed
no public PR artifacts/scripts auto-run in private privileged jobs
rollback: restore last verified private source/dependency/adapter mapping through existing review process
use recorded private release and Pages manifest; preserve data and research history
production_owner: existing private repository only; no new schedule/publish/research writer
github_actions_cost: public code CI can be free standard-hosted compute; private production/full validation cost continues
